Thanks for asking—I’m still running a slight fever and the cough hasn’t let up, so I’m heading to the hospital right after breakfast to get checked out. Hope your skin calms down soon; that sounds really uncomfortable.
Yeah, it’s been keeping me up a bit. Good luck with your visit—I hope they figure out what’s causing your fever quickly. Maybe we’ll both feel better by tomorrow!
